id: bea-† Construction data published by BEA at the detail level do not align with 2017 NAICS industries.  In NAICS, industries are classified based on their production processes, whereas BEA construction is classified by type of structure.  For example, activity by the 2017 NAICS Roofing contractors industry would be split among many BEA construction categories because roofs are built on many types of structures.
